Retest FAIL — 22 Nov 2026 → moved to Bug
Environment: staging-desk.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, Edge + API; account: ndc-staging-owner (owner)
Method: Manual browser + API; customer reply sent from mmohamed@anyware.software

Checked:

  • Customer reply reaches Desk (steps 2–4): agent mail from #6235 at 08:35 UTC → customer reply on #6235 at 08:40:30 UTC (match HeaderChain), no new ticket [PASS]
  • Overview after a real mail arrived (reloaded 08:47 UTC) [FAIL, see below]

Still failing:

  • Overview status: expected a headline from real inbound mail ("Mail is arriving", or a warning when mail waits); actual "We could not check — the check itself failed" on every load.
  • Last email received: expected "Last email received <time>" (here 22 Nov, 10:40 AM Cairo); actual not shown anywhere on the page.
  • Endpoint: GET /api/v1/desk/channels/inbound-health → 404 NOT_FOUND, on page load and 6 direct calls between 08:15 and 08:47 UTC. The page calls it, but staging does not serve it, so the desk part of the fix (desk #272) looks missing or rolled back on staging.

Differs from the developer's note (not the reason for the FAIL):

  • The 9 Nov reply "Re: Check-in" was saved on 21 Nov 18:50 UTC as a new ticket #5992 (message.received match None), not as a reply on #1 "Check-in", which sent the agent mail on 9 Nov 12:50 UTC. #1 had been moved to Marketing and closed on 9 Nov, so this may be by design. Both tickets were later deleted by another tester's cleanup.

Not checked: the red "Customer mail is not reaching tickets" state (needs an email stuck for over an hour; developer-only check).

Evidence: NDC-2837-retest-FAIL.png (attached)
